cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You brought soup? I'll prepare your dinners for a week. Label portions by date, please; guessing isn't meal planning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then when I'm up, I'll fill yours for a month. Properly portioned; we won't waste your space on half-empty tubs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just return the tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send me the measurements for a bigger freezer. Height, width and depth, please. I'll return your tubs full inside it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 date labels, A3 portioning and A5 complete measurements make practical expertise organise A ever-larger repayment.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 stocked freezer exceeds A1 week offer; B4 tiny freezer and tub request cause A5 larger appliance delivered full.

relationship.evidence: B2 cares for illness and B4 limits repayment, so A has to invent a larger form that fits B constraint.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 modest container request into a whole stocked freezer, visibly outdoing the original help.
